integrations.name: Shopify Orders to SAP S/4HANA
integrations.auth_approach: OAuth 2.0 authentication with encrypted credentials stored in key management service.
integrations.error_handling: Failed order payloads are captured and routed to a dead-letter queue for operator inspection.
integrations.retry_behavior: Exponential backoff retry mechanism handles transient errors automatically.
integrations.monitoring: Integration latency and throughput are exported to central observability dashboards.
integrations.sync_considerations: Near-real-time ingestion ensures order delivery latency remains under two minutes.

integrations.name: Order Release to Nordkap Logistics
integrations.auth_approach: SSH key-based SFTP authentication with keys stored in key management service.
integrations.error_handling: Transport failures generate operational alerts and store payload state for manual retry.
integrations.retry_behavior: Scheduled retries with backoff occur prior to alerting operations.
integrations.monitoring: SFTP transport and file batch statuses are tracked via central metrics.
integrations.sync_considerations: Built with modular file adapters to facilitate seamless future migration to direct APIs.

integrations.name: Nordkap Dispatch and Tracking Confirmations
integrations.error_handling: Invalid file formats or parsing errors move files to dead-letter storage and notify administrators.
integrations.retry_behavior: Automatic re-processing on file delivery with backoff for file lock conflicts.
integrations.monitoring: File ingest counts and processing status reported to monitoring dashboard.
integrations.sync_considerations: Inbound files trigger inventory and shipment status updates across systems.

integrations.name: Inventory Position to Shopify and POS
integrations.target_system: Shopify Plus Storefront, In-house POS System
integrations.error_handling: Failed sync operations push messages to a dead-letter queue for review.
integrations.retry_behavior: Exponential backoff retries transient delivery failures.
integrations.monitoring: Inventory freshness and sync frequency are monitored against five-minute target thresholds.
integrations.sync_considerations: Consolidates stock position from SAP and 3PL to calculate available-to-promise inventory.

integrations.name: Customer and Order Data to Snowflake (Nightly)
integrations.error_handling: Batch job failures trigger alerts and record failed status for operator replay.
integrations.retry_behavior: Nightly batch rerun logic with exponential backoff on connection timeout.
integrations.monitoring: Batch execution duration and record counts monitored via metrics logging.
integrations.sync_considerations: Delta sync reduces load by exporting only modified customer and order records.

integrations.name: Intraday Order Events Feed to Snowflake
integrations.error_handling: Event streaming errors push failed events to a dead-letter destination.
integrations.retry_behavior: Immediate backoff retries for streaming channel interruptions.
integrations.monitoring: Streaming lag and payload counts monitored on real-time dashboards.
integrations.sync_considerations: Streams order status events continuously to support operational reporting.

integrations.name: Product Master from SAP to Shopify and Salesforce
integrations.target_system: Shopify Plus Storefront, Salesforce Service Cloud
integrations.error_handling: Failed product synchronization records are saved to dead-letter queue.
integrations.retry_behavior: Exponential backoff retry mechanism for API endpoint rate limits.
integrations.monitoring: Full load and delta synchronization metrics reported to central monitoring.
integrations.sync_considerations: Handles nightly full updates for 9,000 SKUs alongside intraday delta updates.

integrations.name: Finance Postings from Payment Provider to SAP
integrations.auth_approach: Secure SFTP channel with key management integration.
integrations.error_handling: Reconciliation discrepancies are flagged in operational tables for operator review.
integrations.retry_behavior: Scheduled retry logic for missing or locked daily settlement files.
integrations.monitoring: Reconciliation batch status and match rates tracked in observability engine.
integrations.sync_considerations: Performs 3-way reconciliation between settlement files, order data, and SAP ledger.
